transform.sql:
SELECT
  dealership_location,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  SUM(price) AS total_sales_value,
  AVG(price) AS average_sale_price
FROM cars
GROUP BY dealership_location

SELECT
  dealership_location,
  COUNT(*) AS employee_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY dealership_location

SELECT dealership_location, city, state, opened_date
FROM locations

SELECT
  l.dealership_location,
  l.city,
  l.state,
  l.opened_date,
  COALESCE(c.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(c.total_sales_value, 0) AS total_sales_value,
  c.average_sale_price,
  COALESCE(e.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count,
  CAST(COALESCE(c.total_sales_value, 0) / NULLIF(e.employee_count, 0) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS sales_per_employee
FROM locations AS l
LEFT JOIN cars AS c ON c.dealership_location = l.dealership_location
LEFT JOIN employees AS e ON e.dealership_location = l.dealership_location

businessMetrics.name: network_sales_per_employee
businessMetrics.description: Total sales value across the network divided by total headcount.
